title: Red Hat Security Advisory: fence-agents security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities affecting the fence-agents packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 have been addressed. These include a privilege escalation issue in oauthlib due to client identity confusion in token grant handlers (CVE-2026-118669) and several denial of service vulnerabilities in pyasn1 related to processing of ASN.1 data (CVE-2026-119194, CVE-2026-119195, CVE-2026-119196, CVE-2026-119197). The fence-agents packages manage remote power control for cluster nodes, allowing failed or unreachable nodes to be forcibly restarted and removed from clusters. Red Hat has released updates to fix these issues. The update is rated as Important by Red Hat Product Security. No public exploit code or exploitation in the wild has been reported.
